title: SecureMed-LLM
subtitle: A privacy-preserving framework for safeguarding clinical language models
problem: Language models that generate clinical text from medical images can expose protected health information (PHI) at several points: in the training data, in the generated report and in transit. Single safeguards each cover only one of these points.
role: Author of the thesis project and of its public repository.
approach: A layered pipeline for chest X-ray report generation that combines anonymisation, differentially private training, adversarial-robustness evaluation, LLM-based output validation and encrypted report delivery. It was evaluated on the Open-I dataset.
limitations: This is a research prototype. It is not a deployed clinical system and has not been clinically validated. Results come from one public dataset (Open-I) and should not be read as security guarantees.
